scope: Read-only synthesis of SCE implementation, run receipts, aggregate result files, and preparation manifests. No personal records copied; no protected files, public configs, or run inputs edited.

status_definitions.adopted_infrastructure: Operational code or evaluation machinery is in use; this status does not claim research efficacy.
status_definitions.retained_candidate: A mechanism has evidence or a registered reason to keep studying, but is not part of a frozen production configuration.
status_definitions.no_stable_improvement_deferred: A completed comparison did not meet its registered or practical improvement bar; retained as evidence and paused for now.
status_definitions.preparation_only_not_run: Data, code, prompts, or manifests are prepared, but the corresponding simulation/API call did not occur.
status_definitions.diagnostic_only: Offline description or sensitivity analysis of existing observations; no new behavior was simulated.

pipeline.implemented: Topic reviews and source archives cover inflation expectations, price experience, CE/SCE spending, news exposure, confidence, numeracy, age experience, and response reporting.
pipeline.remaining: Literature motivates hypotheses; it does not directly identify portable agent parameters or establish this project's causal mechanisms.

pipeline.implemented: SCE StudySpec, scripted/LLM behavior, local run entry, and one-way runtime export exist.
pipeline.remaining: A self-contained locked research environment and a complete prospective B-line evaluation have not been delivered.

pipeline.implemented: SCE whitelist portraits, Core/Normal extension, CE synthetic spending sidecars, and macro population-update backtests exist.
pipeline.remaining: A-line contemporaneous portraits are retrospective; QSP5 external use is unapproved; employment/income macro changes were not wired into formal P.

pipeline.implemented: Historical macro/news environments, release-date checks, 77-signal packages, news allocation, and recent EIA/USDA price inputs have code and run manifests.
pipeline.remaining: Some gasoline/news vintage and NYT print-publication boundaries remain unverified; model training knowledge is unknown.

pipeline.implemented: Core SCE coverage is audited for 106 months and about 130,216 respondent-month records; related CE/SCE spending and macro sources are archived at multiple levels.
pipeline.remaining: Microdata first-release dates and complete vintage coverage are incomplete; local coverage is not a claim about today's live release frontier.

pipeline.implemented: Local SocioVerse2 execution supports deterministic scripted and real OpenAI-compatible calls; actual DeepSeek SCE runs completed.
pipeline.remaining: Experiments are mostly small retrospective development runs. Provider aliases do not prove immutable model weights or training cutoff; cloud v4 was not run.

pipeline.implemented: Local run directories preserve messages, observations, DuckDB, effective configs, source snapshots, hashes, and conservative cost ledgers.
pipeline.remaining: Most detailed artifacts are ignored/local-only. Cloud v2 lacks historical observations, distinct run ID, and cost ledger; cloud v3 has an unexplained newline conversion boundary.

pipeline.implemented: Common Q9 approximate scorer, Q8/Q9 separation, group/distribution metrics, source checks, and long-window offline baselines exist.
pipeline.remaining: Open-tail and gapped-bin Beta scoring differences remain; national official values, project re-scoring, and selected-sample metrics are not interchangeable.

pipeline.implemented: Experiment receipts, aggregate summaries, plots, and local HTML reviews exist.
pipeline.remaining: No final research paper/report is complete; several directory READMEs retain stale pending/no-results text.

experiment_families.scale: Public microdata comparison for 2020-01 and 2022-06; 3,741 sealed holdout rows checked for kernel migration; no LLM calls.
experiment_families.result: Uniform and adjacent-bin triangular branches closely match official individual derived values; open-tail/gapped generalized-Beta cases retain error. Official-derived headline aggregation matches, while project fitted headline differs by about 0.007-0.011pp in the two cited months.
experiment_families.qualification: Frozen common project approximation, not the exact FRBNY implementation.

experiment_families.p_change: Cloud v2/v3: 20 synthetic portraits per target month; later local runs use audited SCE portrait whitelist.
experiment_families.e_change: Cloud: six BLS first-release signals for 2021-05/06; local main run: 77 macro signals plus 30 news items per month.
experiment_families.b_change: Cloud v2/v3 deterministic scripted; cloud v4 configured real LLM but not executed; local harness later made real LLM calls.
experiment_families.scale: Cloud v2 and v3 each produced 40 scripted answers (20 x 2 months), simulation LLM calls 0. Cloud v3 observation content was corroborated 40/40; sidecar newline conversion remains unexplained. Cloud v4 quote was unavailable and it was not run.
experiment_families.result: Cloud runs establish partial workflow/provenance evidence, not behavior efficacy. Local real-call evidence is covered by the 300-Core family.

experiment_families.p_change: Monthly SCE frame: 1,234 in 2021-05 and 1,297 in 2021-06; 300 Core sampled per month, remainder Normal.
experiment_families.e_change: 77 macro signals plus 30 title/abstract news items; monthly cutoff at CPI release date.
experiment_families.b_change: DeepSeek official alias deepseek-flash; sce-q8-q9-v2-abstract; temperature 0.5; monthly cold starts.
experiment_families.scale: 600 real API calls, 600 valid answers, zero retries; conservative estimated cost USD 0.536425 (not vendor invoice).
experiment_families.result: Q9 median 2.952% versus 4.000% in May and 3.860% versus 4.802% in June. Normal expansion did not reliably improve Core direct weighting. Simulated cross-person Q9 spread was far below the full-month SCE spread.
experiment_families.qualification: End-to-end development run, not prospective validation or a successful SCE reconstruction.

experiment_families.dates: 2026-10-07: early 60-month run; subsequently extended to latest verified coverage
experiment_families.p_change: Statistical population-distribution reconstruction; no simulated individual P changes.
experiment_families.e_change: Historical national SCE/CPI first-release data for rolling baselines; no Agent E package.
experiment_families.b_change: Persistence, AR(1), ARX, 12-month mean, rule update, and population-conditional statistical reconstruction; no LLM.
experiment_families.scale: Early national run: 60 months (2020-01 through 2024-12), zero LLM calls. Latest national headline: 80 months (2020-01 through 2026-08); microdata: 70 months (2020-01 through 2025-10). Separate Core-size resampling uses prior answers/observed responses, not new generation.
experiment_families.result: Early 60-month metrics remain a historical run record. Latest month-end national headline MAE: persistence 0.303750pp, AR(1) 0.346464, fixed 25% rule-update Agent 0.438750 across 80 months. Mid-month metrics cover 79 months: 0.231646, 0.256516, 0.356962pp respectively. ARX covers 66/67 months and must be compared on common months. Latest microdata W1: historical distribution 0.501307 versus population-conditioned 0.500891; age-education group median error 0.579344 to 0.482376 across 70 months. Different windows/targets are not ranked together.
experiment_families.qualification: The latest 80-month national and 70-month microdata offline baselines are the current comparison reference; the older 60-month results remain an archived early-window run. None is a long-run LLM validation. Compare each metric only with matching months, data target, population and scoring contract.

experiment_families.p_change: Short comparison: 20 existing Core cases per month, 2021-05/06. Annual reuse: same legacy 20-person panel in 2021-01..12.
experiment_families.e_change: Short comparison uses old matched P/E and messages. Annual reuse uses only four BLS signals; 220/240 Qwen messages include prior DeepSeek point forecasts.
experiment_families.b_change: DeepSeek reference; Llama 3.1-70B and Qwen2.5-72B completed short cases; Llama 3.3-70B and 3.1-8B failed format gate with too few valid cases. Qwen annual reuse generated 240 answers.
experiment_families.scale: Short: Llama 41 requests/40 valid; Qwen 40 valid after a blocked first route; follow-up Qwen 40 valid, Llama3.3 4 valid, Llama3.1-8B 1 valid. Annual: Qwen 246 requests/240 valid; new DeepSeek calls 0. Separate 4-model x 300 x 12 preparation: 14,400 candidate requests, calls 0.
experiment_families.result: Qwen had a small annual level MAE decrease (0.952 to 0.884pp) but improved only 6/12 months, trend direction fell 5/11 to 3/11, and W1 worsened 2.546 to 2.642pp. No model met adoption criteria; incomplete Llama samples are not ranked.
experiment_families.qualification: Provider aliases do not establish weight snapshots or training cutoffs; annual legacy reuse is not the current rich E nor an independent Qwen trajectory.

experiment_families.p_change: Synthetic CE donor shares for food, gasoline, shelter, and other; no real SCE household receipt or purchase-frequency record.
experiment_families.e_change: Compared common facts with basket display and/or information ordering; Q8/Q9 survey unchanged.
experiment_families.b_change: Same DeepSeek model and base questionnaire; tested answer-view prompt changes.
experiment_families.scale: 2021-05/06, 20 people per month, five arms, 200 real answers; temperature 0.
experiment_families.result: Full mechanism lowered Q9 individual MAE by about 0.289pp in May but only 0.002pp in June. Model cross-person IQR stayed below 1pp versus about 5.2/5.4pp in the selected SCE samples.

experiment_families.p_change: Local QSP5/SCE respondent-month linkage is analyzed; proposed LLM treatment would send genuine nine-category shares.
experiment_families.e_change: Proposed trial holds existing 77 signals/news fixed.
experiment_families.b_change: Proposed no-basket, own-basket, and shuffled-basket groups; no actual model call.
experiment_families.scale: 15,931 overlapping respondent-months linked; 11,327 complete weighted baskets in local analysis. Proposed 32 people x 2 months x 3 conditions = 192 prompts; rule dry-runs only, zero LLM calls.
experiment_families.result: Own-basket statistical model improves Q9 individual MAE only 0.039-0.063pp in 2022-24 chronological checks; Q8 not improved. Specific external-send approval was blocked because prior consent covered synthetic CE baskets, not real QSP5 shares.
experiment_families.qualification: Local association analysis is complete; external LLM experiment remains awaiting explicit authorization.

experiment_families.p_change: Add current SCE Q1 self-reported household financial change to prompt; five categories, ten selected cases per month.
experiment_families.b_change: Same baseline prompt/model/question; one added Q1 sentence.
experiment_families.scale: 2021-05/06, 50 people per month, baseline and Q1 arms, 200 real answers; one invalid human Q9 in June.
experiment_families.result: Some group-gap differences moved closer to the selected human sample, but Q9 individual MAE worsened slightly both months and spread did not improve consistently.

experiment_families.p_change: Same 48-person selected sample and synthetic CE basket per month.
experiment_families.e_change: Shared, shuffled, or matched single-channel food/gasoline/housing views; news disabled.
experiment_families.scale: 2021-05/06, 48 people per month, three arms, 288 real calls.
experiment_families.result: Matched channel increased cross-person spread, but had higher Q9 individual MAE than shared and no stable advantage over shuffled; distribution distance worsened. Remained much more concentrated than the selected human samples.

experiment_families.p_change: 20 selected SCE portraits per month with the existing synthetic CE basket.
experiment_families.e_change: Compared existing info, recent national dairy-advertisement/gasoline prices, state-to-PADD gasoline, and permuted regional gasoline; food remained national.
experiment_families.result: National recent price lowered selected-sample Q9 median error slightly in both months, but paired intervals included zero and Q8 did not show the same pattern. Regional gasoline did not consistently beat shuffled-region assignment on W1; cross-person spread remained very low.
experiment_families.qualification: Keep national recent-price signal as a weak candidate; defer regional matching. This only tests gasoline geography in these two development months.

experiment_families.p_change: 48 selected prior Core portraits per month; same people and synthetic basket across exposure arms.
experiment_families.e_change: Three shared A1 stories plus five personal items; random versus related-weighted draw. Related draw mixes 50% uniform sampling probability and 50% relevance-weighted probability (weight 2 versus 1), not a 50% relevant-story quota.
experiment_families.b_change: Same DeepSeek model and questionnaire; only news assignment differed.
experiment_families.scale: 2021-05/06 exposure ablation: 48 people x 3 arms x 2 months = 288 calls. Labels: 977 new labels in those windows; another 2,278 candidates labeled for four later periods (286 attempts, 285 valid responses plus one separately authorized recovery). Four-period resident simulations did occur in separate trials: 768 confidence calls and two history-representation trials of 288 calls each, all inheriting news inputs; these are not a four-period shared/random/matched news ablation.
experiment_families.result: Related weighting did not improve May median error over random; June error was lower by 0.168pp, but paired intervals included zero. Distribution distances changed little and inter-person spread remained much narrower than selected humans.
experiment_families.qualification: News labeling/allocation infrastructure works; the direct shared/random/related-weighted efficacy test covers only selected 2021 development samples. Later four-period simulations included news while testing confidence or history changes, but no standalone shared/random/matched news ablation was repeated across those periods.

experiment_families.p_change: Four periods (2022-03, 2022-09, 2023-03, 2024-03), 48 selected people per period; treatment adds an aggregate Gallup-derived confidence sentence, not measured respondent confidence.
experiment_families.e_change: Both arms receive the same three-sentence historical Fed policy brief, same news allocation, prices, and synthetic CE basket.
experiment_families.b_change: Only treatment arm adds the confidence sentence before the same survey questions; two generations per prompt.
experiment_families.scale: 768 API calls, 767 valid answers, one 99% Q9 retained without retry; selected four-period sample only.
experiment_families.result: Equal-cell Q9 center MAE was 0.736 to 0.565pp (about 23.3% lower); distribution W1 improved about 2.3%, while simulated inter-person IQR remained about 0.72pp versus about 5.78pp in selected humans. Seven of eight center-error intervals included zero.
experiment_families.qualification: The treatment contrast is the added confidence wording conditional on a common policy brief. The 0.736-to-0.565 change is not attributed to the shared policy brief or whole policy package; P is not upgraded.

experiment_families.p_change: Age-matched detailed historical inflation background added; same four-period selected sample, 12 per period.
experiment_families.e_change: Existing prices/news and other inputs kept; historical context added before the same questionnaire.
experiment_families.b_change: Compare original input, common history, and age-matched numeric history; two generations.
experiment_families.scale: Four periods x 12 people x 3 arms x 2 generations = 288 calls; 287 valid simulated Q9 responses.
experiment_families.result: Q9 center error: original 0.624pp, common history 0.733, age-matched numeric history 0.969. Age-history W1 3.241 versus original 2.976; simulated inter-person IQR stayed far below selected humans. Registered continue threshold failed.
experiment_families.qualification: Four 12-person development periods are not national samples or an independent holdout.

experiment_families.p_change: Same selected samples and existing P; only historical-experience representation is replaced by brief text in one arm.
experiment_families.e_change: Same inherited news, price, confidence, basket, and questionnaire inputs.
experiment_families.scale: Four periods x 12 people x 3 arms x 2 generations = 288 calls; 287 valid simulated Q9 responses.
experiment_families.result: Text center error 0.742pp versus detailed numeric 0.879pp (15.6% lower), but original input was 0.534pp. W1 was not consistently better; inter-person spread remained far below selected humans. All eight text-vs-numeric center intervals included zero.
experiment_families.qualification: The brief-text arm is paused and not adopted; its outputs are retained for audit only. Its relative improvement over the worse numeric-history arm is not evidence of improvement over the original input. Four 12-person development periods are not national samples or an independent holdout.

experiment_families.p_change: No new P attribute; equivalent wording templates are only candidates.
experiment_families.e_change: No new environment or information change.
experiment_families.b_change: A/B/C are not frozen or approved. Eighteen complete offline message previews and 36 candidate assignments exist, with zero API calls; the variants are not connected to the runner and no equivalent-wording cross-run occurred. The old CE experience-trial expression_shared arm had 40 real answers (20 per month) but changed the answer framing and is not equivalent-wording evidence. Separate offline sensitivity audit re-scored existing outputs only.
experiment_families.scale: No new API. Offline wording preparation: six selected cases x three templates = 18 message previews and 36 candidate assignments; no runner integration or real calls. Probability-shape audit covers 106 survey months and 767 valid existing model answers; 5% deterministic rounding moved selected-sample median by mean absolute 0.182pp, 10% by 0.493pp.
experiment_families.result: Real Q9 nonzero-bin median 4 versus about 8-10 for model answers; around 59% of human answers assigned zero deflation probability, none in this model sample. Data show reporting shape can matter but do not identify a correct injected style.
experiment_families.qualification: User chose not to add rounding/zero-bin behavior to prompts. Equivalent-wording work is offline preparation, not an executed experiment or SFT/RFT. Keep the legacy expression_shared responses separate from the unrun same-facts variants.

experiment_families.p_change: Backtested candidate updates to employment and income category proportions using BLS/BEA release-time observations; formal P unchanged.
experiment_families.e_change: 91 BLS and 92 BEA release files; 2,473 dated observations; no simulation E change.
experiment_families.b_change: No Agent call; offline population proportion prediction only.
experiment_families.scale: 37 evaluation months, zero LLM calls; 2,473 dated macro observations with 1,472 BEA cells verified against official workbook.
experiment_families.result: New employment-population ratio MAE 1.349pp and plus participation 1.359 versus unemployment-rate update 1.323 and old portrait 1.466. Income distribution candidates did not beat old portraits overall.
experiment_families.qualification: No fixed P/E behavioral transmission test; t-10 portrait availability assumption and incomplete revision history limit PIT claims.

state_conflicts_and_limits.details: population/README.md, environment/README.md, simulation/README.md, trajectory/README.md, reports/README.md, and the top-level study README contain template-era pending/no-results text despite current code and later run receipts.

state_conflicts_and_limits.issue: Selected-sample, national, and small-period outputs differ
state_conflicts_and_limits.details: The early 60-month aggregate baseline has since been extended: latest national headline covers 80 months (through 2026-08), and latest microdata distribution covers 70 months (through 2025-10). 300-Core monthly runs, 20/48-person mechanism arms, and four-period 12/48-person studies still use different populations, questions, weights, and scoring contracts; numerical metrics are not directly ranked across these designs.
The QSP5 v4 manifest is a prepared trial; external API run was blocked because earlier consent covered synthetic CE basket shares, not real QSP5 shares. The current inventory treats it as not run.

state_conflicts_and_limits.issue: Scoring freeze does not mean exact official implementation
state_conflicts_and_limits.details: The same pinned approximate scorer is applied to human and model answers; Beta fit residual differences remain, especially in open tails and gapped bins.

state_conflicts_and_limits.issue: Candidate improvements are not production adoption
state_conflicts_and_limits.details: Confidence passed a registered continue-study threshold but is not in formal P. Text history improved against numeric history while remaining worse than its同期 original-input control. News, recent-price, and confidence outcomes remain selected-sample development evidence.

The 14,400-request annual four-model batch, standalone four-period shared/random/matched news ablation, QSP5 LLM trial, and equivalent-wording experiment have no completed calls. Four-period confidence and two history-representation simulations did run and included news inputs; they do not substitute for a news-allocation ablation.

protected_files.handling: Read-only; not edited, restored, committed, or used as an input to new model calls.
